# Fixtures

Small synthetic speech files used by the integration tests and evals. All are generated by
`make_fixtures.sh` (open-jtalk for Japanese, espeak-ng for English, ffmpeg for padding and muxing);
the reference texts and timing facts are in `fixtures.json`.

| file | content | size |
|------|---------|------|
| `ja_short.wav` | Japanese sentence, 1.0 s leading silence, 16 kHz mono PCM | ~300 KB |
| `en_short.wav` | English sentences, 1.0 s leading silence, 16 kHz mono PCM | ~250 KB |
| `lecture_short.mp4` | test pattern video + the Japanese part, 1 s gap, the English part (AAC) | ~360 KB |

The Japanese voice is `nitech-jp-atr503-m001` (Nagoya Institute of Technology, CC BY 3.0). The English
voice is espeak-ng. No real people are recorded. Whisper models are not committed; the tests download
`base` into the Hugging Face cache on first run (about 145 MB).
